review.description: S3 qualification adds sampled concurrent workload RSS separately from individual-process RSS, requires meaningful root/child coverage, fails closed on unavailable safe targeting, and records interrupted nonzero results after bounded owned-workload cleanup. Existing local inventory and hosted comparison behavior remain.
review.implementation: Read WorkloadMemory session/descendant traversal and PID/start-time tracking; metrics reject missing root, concurrent children or RSS. measure installs recording SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers before Popen, keeps the leader unreaped, and cleanup sends to its pinned group and revalidated pidfds, then boundedly reaps. Schema2 declares sampling limits and restores handlers.
review.tests: Read actual simultaneous 48MiB allocations including a new-session child, malformed/missing data and partial-read failures. Real SIGINT/SIGTERM probes cover measurement and cleanup, handler restoration, stale-PID/unrelated sentinel preservation and interrupted summaries. Independent subreaper fallback deliberately stalls production cooperation and kills/reaps only owned children; unavailable targeting fails before launch or during cleanup.
